Edit apps/web/src/components/kanban-board/column/column-header.tsx (full current content in inputs; a Popover usage example from this codebase is also in inputs — copy its import style).

Add the WIP-limit indicator and its inline editor:

1. Badge. Replace the existing count span's body with a rule on `column.wipLimit`:
   - null/undefined -> render `{column.tasks.length}` with today's classes, unchanged.
   - set and `column.tasks.length <= column.wipLimit` -> render `{column.tasks.length}/{column.wipLimit}` with today's classes.
   - set and `column.tasks.length > column.wipLimit` -> render `{column.tasks.length}/{column.wipLimit}` with over-capacity classes `bg-destructive/15 text-destructive font-semibold` in place of `bg-muted text-muted-foreground`, and `title={t("tasks:kanban.wipLimitExceeded")}`.
2. Editor. When `canUpdateProjects()` from useWorkspacePermission() is true, wrap the badge in a Popover (Popover / PopoverTrigger / PopoverContent from "@/components/ui/popover") whose content has: an `<Input type="number" min={1}>` bound to local state `limitValue` (initialised from `column.wipLimit?.toString() ?? ""`), a Save button (`t("tasks:kanban.saveWipLimit")`) and a Clear button (`t("tasks:kanban.clearWipLimit")`). Give the trigger `title={t("tasks:kanban.setWipLimit")}`. When canUpdateProjects() is false render the bare badge with no trigger, no popover and no edit affordance.
3. Mutation. Use `useUpdateColumn()` from "@/hooks/mutations/column/use-update-column". Save parses limitValue as an integer and calls `mutate({ id: column.columnId, projectId: project.id, data: { wipLimit: parsed } })`; Clear, and Save on an empty/blank/non-positive input, send `{ wipLimit: null }`. Close the popover after either.

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- The mutation id MUST be `column.columnId` (the database UUID). `column.id` is the SLUG here — using it will 404.
- Do not change `getColumnIcon(column.id, ...)` or `status={column.id}` on CreateTaskModal. Both must keep using `column.id`.
- Every user-facing string uses a static `t("tasks:kanban.<key>")` key from the list above. No literal English in JSX, no template-built keys.
- Do NOT add blocking: nothing here may prevent creating, moving or updating a task. This is an indicator only.
- Leave the archive button, the add-task button, CreateTaskModal, ArchiveTasksModal and handleConfirmArchive exactly as they are.

Implements FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-16.

Follow the house integration pattern in the reference file in inputs EXACTLY (resetTestDatabase in beforeEach, createWorkspaceMember fixture, mockAuthenticatedSession / mockAnonymousSession, `const { app } = createApp()` then `app.request("/api/...")`).

Set up: a workspace member, a project, and a column in that project (create the column through `POST /api/column/:projectId` so the route is exercised).

1. AC-2 — POST /api/column/:projectId with `wipLimit: 4` returns 200 and the created column has wipLimit 4; re-read the row via db.query to confirm it persisted.

4. AC-12 — GET /api/task/tasks/:projectId returns each column with `id` STILL equal to the column slug, plus a distinct `columnId` equal to the column's database UUID, plus `wipLimit`. Assert explicitly that `column.id === <slug>` and `column.id !== column.columnId`. Also assert a column with no limit set reports `wipLimit: null`.

Do not add enforcement assertions — this feature never blocks anything. Write only this one file.
